public/diagrams/dg32-lite-architecture.s.shows: The image is a block diagram illustrating the DG32-LITE system architecture and its functional modules. It details sub-systems including the safety core, memory and boot, supervision, motor drive, sensing and math, and connectivity, interconnected via an on-chip bus to external hardware.
visibleText: DG32-LITE · one 50 MHz clock domain · 130 nm CMOS · QFN-64
On-chip bus · two masters (CPU, DMA) · deterministic latency · unmapped address → bus error, never a hang

public/diagrams/dg32-2dom-architecture.s.shows: This block diagram illustrates the system architecture of the DG32-2DOM chip, showing functional modules divided across two clock domains. A 50 MHz control domain communicates with a 114 MHz INT8 attention engine compute domain through clock-domain bridges.
visibleText: 50 MHz control domain · identical to DG32-LITE
114 MHz compute domain · INT8 attention engine
On-chip bus · bus error, never a hang
